changelog: Ice page: new "reverse mode" — work backwards from a target total capacity (kW) or daily ice output (kg/day) to the unit size you need; switch between forward and reverse with one tap
In reverse mode the water-mass and freezing-time fields are greyed out and marked, so they are clearly not missing
Ice page safety margin is now wired to the parameter config, so config changes apply there too and both pages share one basis
Reverse-mode target limits and defaults are now configurable (revLimits); no code change is needed when a customer's scale exceeds the old range
Config tool: new "ice page parameters" panel stating exactly what can and cannot be changed, and why
English edition: all remaining Chinese removed from pages, exported reports and runtime messages
New configurable parameter system: unit capacities, volume limits, quotation templates and defaults are now driven by config files, loaded automatically online
Config hot-update for app and web: upload the new config file and every device picks it up without reinstalling
Ice page: removed the ambient-temperature correction factor — required cooling now depends only on water amount and ice temperature; unit selection still uses the ambient column of the capacity table
Ice page: added "estimated daily ice output" — derived from the recommended unit's capacity at the given conditions over 24h continuous operation
Ice page: target ice temperature now has a -25 °C lower limit — any lower input is calculated at -25 °C with a notice, matching the cold room page
Fixed cold room page showing a temperature in the input box that differed from the value actually used in the calculation
Fixed the capacity library not being listed on first load
note: PRIMST Cold Room Cooling Load Calculator - English edition. pageVersion triggers live page update; apkVersion/apkUrl trigger the APK update prompt.
